name: Copy button puts the unspaced IBAN on the clipboard
title: SC-07-04-02 Copy button puts the unspaced IBAN on the clipboard
description:
Verified by the test cases listed as steps. The Gherkin steps were not executed one by one.

Given the resident dashboard shows the spaced 26-character virtual IBAN
When the resident taps the copy button
Then the clipboard holds the unspaced IBAN
And a toast confirms the copy
